title: Time Budget New Cards
user: An Anki or CSV-flashcard learner who needs to choose how many new items to introduce within a fixed daily study budget despite mixed difficulty.
smallest_useful_product: An offline companion that ingests review duration/history or a CSV, estimates the marginal time cost of new cards, and recommends today’s safe new-card cap.
success_measure: At least 60% of pilot users remain within ±20% of their chosen study budget for 21 of 30 days while continuing to add new material.
constraints: Do not claim clinical learning optimization; estimates must disclose uncertainty and support manual correction; no account is required.
